prompt:
To detect potential duplicate or near-duplicate customers in
customer360__conversion_funnel_analysis (~441,119 rows), compare every record
against every other record via a self-join:

SELECT a.marketo_lead_id, b.marketo_lead_id,
       (ABS(a.journey_completeness_score - b.journey_completeness_score) + ABS(a.weighted_engagement_score - b.weighted_engagement_score) + ABS(a.customer_health_score - b.customer_health_score) + ABS(a.estimated_customer_ltv - b.estimated_customer_ltv)) AS distance
  FROM customer360__conversion_funnel_analysis a, customer360__conversion_funnel_analysis b
 WHERE a.marketo_lead_id <> b.marketo_lead_id;

Compute the distance over (journey_completeness_score, weighted_engagement_score, customer_health_score, estimated_customer_ltv). Return ALL
(a.marketo_lead_id, b.marketo_lead_id, distance) pairs whose distance
is below the median. Do not pre-filter or sample.
